description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Excise Notification No. 03/2023 in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2361/44 Dated December 08,2023 was passed by Parliament on May 13,2024.
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the parliamentary approval of an Excise Notification (No. 03/2023) issued under the Excise Ordinance. It deals with a regulatory matter (amendment to an ordinance) and the formal notification of its legal status after being passed by Parliament, which fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While a government official (the Secretary) is named, this is only in their capacity as the issuer of the notification; the core content is about the legal/regulatory process, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
